decision.reason: Existing CHELSA occurrence-niche assets were built for focal sampling systems rather than the full 17-tip resolved orientation panel. Only C. brevicaule and C. irumtiense currently overlap the resolved 20-tip orientation panel with equivalent vetted focal niche assets.
decision.next_required_computation: Extend the source-name-guarded occurrence plus CHELSA niche pipeline to the other 15 resolved orientation tips before estimating branch-wise niche shifts or transition-niche concordance.
do_not_do: do not impute niche values from taxon names or broad regions
do not reuse latitude as a causal niche variable
do not call the existing two-tip overlap a branch-wise evolutionary test
do not relabel repeated orientation state change as adaptive convergence
